findings.Detail: Application control present but not fully enforcing (0 AppLocker rule(s), WDAC status 2).
findings.Ml1Requirement: Executables, scripts, installers, HTA and control-panel applets are prevented from running in standard-user-writable locations (AppLocker/WDAC enforced).
findings.Ml2Gap: ML2 extends control to all locations, adds Microsoft "recommended block" driver/rule sets, and logs allowed/blocked execution centrally.

findings.Detail: 5 pending software update(s); last patch 57 day(s) ago.
findings.Ml1Requirement: Patches for applications are applied within one month (two weeks for internet-facing / 48h if exploited); a vulnerability scanner is used at least fortnightly.
findings.Ml2Gap: ML2 tightens the SLA to two weeks and requires the scanner to run weekly against applications.

findings.Detail: No Office macro policy set (Office not installed, but the policy should still be defined).
findings.Ml1Requirement: Office macros are disabled for users without a business need; macros from the internet are blocked; users cannot change the setting.
findings.Ml2Gap: ML2 adds antivirus scanning of allowed macros and blocks Win32 API calls from macros; macro events are logged.

findings.Detail: Internet Explorer still enabled and no attack-surface-reduction hardening applied.
findings.Ml1Requirement: Web browsers do not process Java or web advertisements from the internet; Internet Explorer 11 is disabled/removed; browser security settings cannot be changed by users.
findings.Ml2Gap: ML2 blocks additional ASR vectors (Office child processes, credential theft, PowerShell/script abuse) and logs blocked events.

findings.Detail: Mostly restricted, but: UAC is disabled.
findings.Ml1Requirement: Privileged access is limited and validated; privileged accounts are separate from day-to-day accounts and cannot browse the web or read email; unprivileged users are not local administrators.
findings.Ml2Gap: ML2 adds just-in-time / time-limited admin, a separate privileged operating environment, and logging of privileged access.

findings.Detail: Microsoft Windows 11 Enterprise Evaluation; last OS update 57 day(s) ago - outside the one-month window.
findings.Ml1Requirement: Operating systems are patched within one month (two weeks for internet-facing); unsupported operating systems are replaced.
findings.Ml2Gap: ML2 tightens the SLA to two weeks and requires a vulnerability scanner to confirm OS patch levels weekly.

findings.Detail: No MFA mechanism detected on this host (standalone lab). MFA is enforced at the identity provider, not locally.
findings.Ml1Requirement: MFA is used for remote access, for internet-facing services, and by privileged users; it is phishing-resistant where required.
findings.Ml2Gap: ML2 requires MFA for all users of internet-facing services and logs successful/failed MFA events.

findings.Detail: No backup solution or restore points detected.
findings.Ml1Requirement: Backups of important data, software and configuration are performed and retained per business needs; restoration is tested; unprivileged accounts cannot modify or delete backups.
findings.Ml2Gap: ML2 requires more frequent backups, coordinated restoration testing, and that unprivileged accounts cannot access other users' backups.
